nodes.description: mapping(address => uint) public balances; stores token balances of every holder.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; stores spender allowances granted by owners.
uint public totalSupply = 100000000000000000 * 10 ** 9; total token supply minted to the deployer.
string public name = "TerrierInu"; token name.
string public symbol = "TERR"; token symbol.
uint public decimals = 9; token decimal precision.
constructor() assigns the entire totalSupply to balances[msg.sender].
function balanceOf(address owner) public view returns(uint); reads balances[owner].
function transfer(address to, uint value) public returns(bool); checks sender balance then credits 'to' and debits msg.sender.
function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value) public returns(bool); checks balance and allowance, then moves tokens without decrementing allowance.
function approve(address spender, uint value) public returns(bool); writes an arbitrary allowance for msg.sender.
External caller address used as the implicit sender in constructor, transfer, transferFrom and approve.
Balance mutation path in transfer: balances[to] += value; balances[msg.sender] -= value; guarded only by a require on msg.sender balance.
Balance mutation path in transferFrom: balances[to] += value; balances[from] -= value; the allowance is never decremented, enabling unlimited repeated spends of an approval.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value; unconditional allowance overwrite at uncontrolled magnitude (unlimited approval).
Parameter 'owner' of balanceOf(address owner).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint value).
Parameter 'value' of transfer(address to, uint value).
Parameter 'from' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).
Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).
Parameter 'value' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value).

Parameter 'value' of approve(address spender, uint value).

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to select the initial recipient of totalSupply.
constructor reads totalSupply to credit the deployer balance.
constructor writes balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for 'from' and 'to'.
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] to validate the spend.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
transfer uses msg.sender for the balance requirement and for the debit branch.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is checked.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner granting the allowance.
transfer execution reaches the unsafe balance update path after the require check.
transferFrom execution reaches the unsafe balance update path that leaves allowance untouched.
approve execution reaches the unconditional allowance overwrite.
balanceOf consumes the owner parameter when indexing balances.
transfer consumes the 'to' parameter as the balance credit target.
transfer consumes the 'value' parameter in the requirement and in the arithmetic.
transferFrom consumes the 'from' parameter as the allowance owner and debit target.
transferFrom consumes the 'to' parameter as the balance credit target.
transferFrom consumes the 'value' parameter in the requirement and in the arithmetic.
approve consumes the 'spender' parameter as the allowance key.
approve consumes the 'value' parameter as the allowance amount.
transfer parameter 'value' flows into the balance arithmetic performed by the unsafe update path.
transferFrom parameter 'value' flows into the balance arithmetic performed by the unsafe update path.
approve parameter 'value' is written directly into the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'owner' parameter only shapes the single read of balances[owner] inside balanceOf and carries no independent semantic value.
The 'to' parameter is only an index selector for the balances write inside transfer.
The 'value' parameter is the amount driving the balance credit/debit arithmetic in transfer's unsafe update path.
The 'from' parameter identifies the allowance owner and debit account inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only an index selector for the balances credit inside transferFrom.
The 'value' parameter drives the balance arithmetic in transferFrom's unsafe update path that omits the allowance decrement.
The 'spender' parameter is only the allowance mapping key set inside approve.
The 'value' parameter is written verbatim as the allowance amount in approve's unsafe state write.
